note: Supplement derived from saved data and installed source; capture files remain unchanged.

agent/qpos.meaning: Joint positions in joint_order: seven revolute arm joints, then two prismatic finger joints.

agent/qvel.meaning: Joint velocities, same joint order as qpos.

sensor_param/base_camera/extrinsic_cv.meaning: World-to-camera extrinsic matrix [R|t], OpenCV camera axes; actual returned shape is (1,3,4).

sensor_param/base_camera/cam2world_gl.meaning: Camera-to-world homogeneous matrix, OpenGL/Blender camera axes.

sensor_param/base_camera/intrinsic_cv.meaning: Camera intrinsics in the OpenCV pixel convention.
sensor_param/base_camera/intrinsic_cv.units: focal length and principal point in pixels; homogeneous row dimensionless

sensor_data/base_camera/rgb.meaning: Policy observation camera RGB, batch,height,width,channel; original unnormalized bytes.

action.dimension_7: Absolute target for controlling finger; target_m=0.015+0.025*a. Second finger mimics first.

gripper_values.-1: target -0.01 m, closing command; not an attainable negative physical opening

namespaces.obs_t/*: Independent numerical copy of actual reset observation before action.
namespaces.obs_tp1/*: Independent numerical copy of env.step returned next observation.
namespaces.info_t/*: Reset diagnostics: elapsed_steps, success, reconfigure; not policy observation.
namespaces.info_tp1/*: Step diagnostics: elapsed_steps, success; not policy observation.
namespaces.diagnostic/cube_pose_*: Simulator ground-truth cube world pose [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz], for offline validation only.
namespaces.diagnostic/arm_target_qpos: Controller's commanded joint positions in rad; not measured next qpos.
namespaces.diagnostic/gripper_target_qpos: Controller target for the two finger joints, in m.
namespaces.step_index_*: Control-step counters relative to the explicit seeded reset.
namespaces.time_*_s: Simulation time relative to that reset, not wall-clock time.
namespaces.reward: Task shaping reward, scalar per environment; not a success flag.
namespaces.terminated: Task terminal-state flag returned by env.step.
namespaces.truncated: External cutoff/time-limit flag returned by env.step.
